analysis.reason: The test expected HTTP 200 with product details for /products/1 but the API returned 404 and message 'Requested item not found'. The execution result alone does not indicate whether this is an application defect (missing product or routing issue), a wrong test expectation (product ID 1 not guaranteed to exist), or an environment/test-data problem. No external API contract or test-data setup evidence was provided to disambiguate the cause.
analysis.recommendedAction: Investigate further: (1) Verify test data: confirm product with ID 1 exists in the environment used for the test. (2) Check API documentation/contract for expected behavior when an ID is absent vs present. (3) Re-run the request for known-existing product IDs and examine server logs and metrics for errors. (4) If product 1 should exist, capture server logs/traces to identify application defect; otherwise update test expectations or test data provisioning.
